newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates edge up to end at 20.50 pct. [CORRECTED 08:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates edge up to end at 20.50 pct. [CORRECTED 08:10 GMT]

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates edged up in tight liquidity on Wednesday to close at 20.50 percent compared with 20.25 percent on Tuesday, traders said.
"Large amounts are probably tied up in the central bank's one-week reverse repo faciltiy," said Sandor Szatmari of Creditanstalt (corrects bank from Commerzbank).

He added that the increase in the overnight rate remained modest due to the fact that at the beginning of the banks' two-week reserve period market participants were in no hurry to top up their reserves.
Szatmari also said significant amounts would probably flow back from the one-week reverse repo on Thursday or Friday preventing a further rise.
"I expect the rates to hover between 20.125 and 20.375 percent (in the coming days)," he said.
